prose: THE EMPIRE OF BAAL continues. This episode follows the golden thread westward into Celtic Europe, tracing the bull god's fingerprints across Ireland and Britain.

What do Celtic mythology, Beltane, and the ancient Phoenicians have in common? Chance Garton and Dylan Saccoccio follow the linguistic and ritual signature of the bull god Baal across the ancient world, from the Mediterranean into Gaul, Britain, and Ireland, tracing one continuous system of ancient religion across thousands of years.
ext: The members' half is jam packed, including the Baal connection to Sibyls, Government, and the technological surveillance state. This is where Baal jumps out of history and reveals its ubiquity in our modern society.
